rules: Use multi-stage builds to minimise final image size
Pin base image to a specific major version tag
Use npm ci for deterministic installs
Copy only built artefacts into the runner stage
Use EXPOSE to document the listening port
securityRequirements: No secrets or .env files copied into the image
Add a .dockerignore that excludes node_modules and .git
Use node:XX-alpine (not latest or slim) to minimise attack surface
USER instruction must appear before CMD/ENTRYPOINT
